Flip a coin

Tap the coin or the flip button to toss it. The coin spins and lands on heads or tails, and the tally counts every result until you reset it.

Each flip is an independent 50/50 draw from your device's secure random generator, so earlier flips never influence the next one.

Questions

Is this coin flip fair?

Yes. Heads and tails each have exactly a 50% chance on every flip.

Why did I get heads five times in a row?

Streaks are normal in fair random sequences. Any given five flips have a 1 in 32 chance of all being heads.

Does it work without internet?

Yes, after your first visit.
